title_original: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Procedure and Methods for Voting)
(1) When an agricultural cooperative organization intends to hold a general meeting vote as required by Article 5(1) of the Act, the chairman of the organization must convene the general meeting.
(2) When the chairman of an agricultural cooperative organization convenes a general meeting as required by Article 1(1), the chairman must send a notice of the meeting to the members of the general meeting, specifying the purpose and agenda of the meeting, and the date and location of the meeting, no later than 10 days before the meeting.
(3) Voting shall be one vote per person, and shall be conducted by secret ballot.
